perks.desc: Dealing a portion of the magazine as precision damage grants this weapon bonus damage. The shot count is reset whenever the weapon is reloaded or stowed.

perks.name: Voltshot
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target overcharges this weapon for a short period of time, causing it to jolt on its next hit.

perks.name: Dragonfly

perks.name: One for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

notes: Adamsdown_Boy - information as at v8.0.0.6 PvE / PvE-Boss / PvE-BossSpec / PvE-EndGame / PvE-God / M+KB / Controller): PvE pick for killing boss-tier Subjugators. As per @mossy_max (https://x.com/mossy_max/status/1804893174965338387) - boss-tier Subjugators have a 20% damage reduction to all non-matching damage, going up to 30% DR to all damage after they "screech", which counts as a shield in-game and reacts to shield-based trait perks. If you do have a Path of Least Resistance - still obtainable from the Seraph Shield mission - it's shapeable, so you can craft exactly the roll to help. First, a barrel that helps with stability, to keep your reticule steady will help land consistent crits. Then, as a Backup Mag mod gets you to the maximum of 107 shots, Light Mag or Tactical Mag boost reload speed. In the first trait perk column, Adaptive Munitions increases damage to non-matching Subjugator "shields" by for a total damage boost of around +45% after 15 hits (+73% when enhanced). In the second column you can stack damage further - with Focused Fury for +20% once you've hit crits with half the mag, or if there are minor adds around, One for All grants +35% damage for 10s when procced. You could use the Ambush origin trait for a little extra damage, or Omolon Fluid Dynamics for bonus stability at the start of the fight. Recommended MW: Stability, with a Backup Mag mod
Speedrunner's Shopping List: "Avoiding primary swaps/Special single shot add clear/Shooting bricks" (good for: all S21 raids and dungeons)

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "I think the Path of Least Resistance is going to be a crowd favorite. Adaptive munitions to crush shields and voltshot to clear rooms. There is the classic “Musketeer” combo of stats for all and one for all. As well as some decent damage through focused fury. Subsistence I think is the best for mobbing but without a direct damage bonus you might be a bit underwhelmed with its performance." Recommended MW - Reload.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB): "Trace rifles have had a very small but solid cult following. The best are still the exotics, but having a near-perfect hipfire juiced up auto rifle is hard to argue against. Path of Least Resistance doesn’t offer a lot in terms of lethality to keep the ball rolling once it does get started. Neutrally it is very strong but I think PvE is where it will survive." Recommended MW - Reload.

Inspired by DMB PvE Podcast 44. First-choice PvE roll for end-game content. Shapeable. The Ambush origin trait is probably more for PvP than PvE, with the extra range, handling and 10% boost to damage for a few moments after combat starts or Omolon Fluid Dynamics' extra stability and reload speed is always welcome. An arc legendary trace rifle to complete the energy set. Stats are a bit of a mixed bag, but there are a few interesting rolls, and at least now you can collect them all! Pump up stability as high as it will go to keep your shots on target. The legendary Coldheart-lite roll - Focused Fury kicks in 20% bonus damage after half of the base battery shots are crits, and if you keep hitting crits, Triple Tap will extend the battery. Keep it in your back pocket for bosses with big crit spots or when someone is using Divinity. MW: Stability, with a damage-boosting (Major, Boss or Taken Spec) mod.

Inspired by DMB PvE Podcast 44. First-choice PvE roll for end-game content. Shapeable. The Ambush origin trait is probably more for PvP than PvE, with the extra range, handling and 10% boost to damage for a few moments after combat starts or Omolon Fluid Dynamics' extra stability and reload speed is always welcome. An arc legendary trace rifle to complete the energy set. Stats are a bit of a mixed bag, but there are a few interesting rolls, and at least now you can collect them all! In use you'll be looking for a combination of a barrel that makes it feel snappier with additional handling or keeps recoil under control by improving the stability, together with a battery that provides some extra stability, reload speed, range or charge. There's a big enough battery to get your three shots to improve all the gunfeel stats with Stats for All, and boost damage by 35% with One for All - this should rip through chunkier adds in end-game content. MW: Stability, with a damage-boosting (Minor, Major or Taken Spec) mod.
